paper_title: First Result for Dark Matter Search by WINERED
notes: First WINERED dark matter decay search: spectroscopy of dSphs Leo V and Tucana II with the 6.5m Magellan Clay telescope, constraining DM decaying to line photons in the 1.8-2.7 eV mass range. This is a new observed 2-sigma limit (not a projection). The paper quotes the ALP photon-coupling bound only approximately in text: g_phigammagamma <~ (2-3)e-11 GeV^-1 assuming NFW profiles for the dSphs, and ~1e-10 GeV^-1 for the conservative generalized Hernquist profile. I emit the CONSERVATIVE (generalized Hernquist) flat bound of 1e-10 GeV^-1 across the validated mass range 1.8-2.7 eV; users preferring the NFW assumption should use ~(2-3)e-11 GeV^-1. Detailed limit curves (with ~20 efficiency-related peaks) are only in Fig. 1 and attached data files, not reproduced in the text, hence approximate values. This is an indirect-detection (decay lifetime) bound relying on dSph D-factors, so no local DM density assumption applies.
